Hungary UEFA, Mali CAF, Venezuela CONMEBOL; membership facts only, not rating points.

limitations: A direct, complete numeric FIFA export was not obtained. Direct-primary-verified points remain zero in this research pack.
Corroboration across publishers is agreement evidence; they may share an upstream feed and are not proven independent observations.
The three ranking pages claim a 211-team table. This pack intentionally captures the complete 79-team application inventory, not all 211 teams.
The source pages state a ranking edition date, not a verified article publication timestamp. publicationDate is unknown.
One secondary source differs for Australia. A selected published value and all conflicting observations are retained.
Ratings are results-based observations; derived game quality and positional ratings will still be model outputs.
